cubilete.rules:
-**Repóker**(5 same dice)🎰 and steal the **BASKET**!
 -**Póker**(4 same) multiplies **x4** the bet!
 -**Full**(3+2) multiplies **x3** the bet!
 -**Trío**(3 same) multiplies **x1.5** the bet!
 -**Double Pair** returns the bet!
 -**Pair** returns half the bet!
